# History playback button and toolbar collapse (2026-01-18 15:06Z)

_**User**_

on @miataru/views/iPhone/Devices Views/DeviceHistoryMap/iPhone_DeviceHistoryMapView.swift there is all those buttons and the tabbar/toolbar at the bottom. Color.accentColor : Color.primary)\n                .contentTransition(.symbolEffect(.replace))\n                .padding(10)\n                .scaleEffect(pulseScale)\n                .animation(\n                    isPlaying\n                        ? .easeInOut(duration: 0.9).repeatForever(autoreverses: true)\n                        : .default,\n                    value: pulseScale\n                )\n\n            // Speed badge shown when playing faster than 1x\n            if isPlaying &amp;&amp; playbackSpeed &gt; 1.0 {\n                Text(String(format: \"%.0fx\", playbackSpeed))\n                    .font(.system(size: 9, weight: .bold))\n                    .foregroundColor(.white)\n                    .padding(.horizontal, 4)\n                    .padding(.vertical, 2)\n                    .background(Color.blue, in: Capsule())\n                    .offset(x: 14, y: -14)\n                    .transition(.scale.combined(with: .opacity))\n                    .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.2), value: playbackSpeed)\n            }\n        }\n        .contentShape(Rectangle())\n        .onTapGesture {\n            onPlayPause()\n        }\n        .onLongPressGesture(minimumDuration: 0.4) {\n            triggerMediumHaptic()\n            onLongPressSpeedUp()\n        }\n        .background {\n            if #available(iOS 26.0, *) {\n                Color.clear.glassEffect(in: .capsule)\n            } else {\n                Color.clear\n            }\n        }\n        .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.10), radius: 4, x: 0, y: 2)\n        .accessibilityLabel(\n            Text(\n                NSLocalizedString(\n                    ",

        "contents": "        // Prefer cached history; do not navigate if cache is empty.\n        if let cachedHistory = DeviceHistoryCacheStore.shared.getHistory(for: device.DeviceID) {\n            if cachedHistory.isEmpty {\n                await MainActor.run {\n                    errorOverlayManager.show(message: NSLocalizedString(\"history_no_data\", comment: \"No history available placeholder\"))\n                }\n            } else {\n                await MainActor.run {\n                    showHistoryView = true\n                }\n            }\n            return\n        }\n\n        guard let url = URL(string: settings.miataruServerURL), !device.DeviceID.isEmpty else {\n            await MainActor.run {\n                errorOverlayManager.show(message: NSLocalizedString(\"server_or_deviceid_invalid\", comment: \"Error: Server or DeviceID invalid\"))\n            }\n            return\n        }\n\n        let requestingDeviceID = thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\n        let requestID = requestingDeviceID.isEmpty ? nil : requestingDeviceID\n\n        do {\n            let data = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocationHistory(\n                serverURL: url,\n                forDeviceID: device.DeviceID,\n                requestingDeviceID: requestID,\n                amount: 10000\n            )\n            let normalized = normalizeHistoryEntries(from: data)\n            let sorted = normalized.sorted { $0.TimestampDate &lt; $1.TimestampDate }\n\n            guard !sorted.isEmpty else {\n                await MainActor.run {\n                    errorOverlayManager.show(message: NSLocalizedString(\"history_no_data\", comment: \"No history available placeholder\"))\n                }\n                return\n            }\n\n            await MainActor.run {\n                DeviceHistoryCacheStore.shared.setHistory(sorted, for: device.DeviceID)\n                showHistoryView = true\n            }\n        } catch let apiError as MiataruAPIClient.APIError {\n            let message = mapHistoryAPIError(apiError)",

        "contents": "    }\n\n    private func formattedDate(_ timestamp: Double) -&gt; String {\n        let date = Date(timeIntervalSince1970: timestamp)\n        return iPhone_DeviceHistoryMapView.timelineDayFormatter.string(from: date)\n    }\n\n    private func rangeHandle(x: CGFloat, systemName: String) -&gt; some View {\n        let visualHandleSize: CGFloat = 26\n        let hitTargetSize: CGFloat = 44 // Increase touch target for easier dragging\n\n        return Capsule()\n            .fill(.thinMaterial)\n            .frame(width: visualHandleSize, height: visualHandleSize)\n            .overlay(\n                Image(systemName: systemName)\n                    .font(.system(size: 10, weight: .bold))\n                    .foregroundStyle(Color.primary)\n            )\n            .shadow(radius: 2)\n            .frame(width: hitTargetSize, height: hitTargetSize)\n            .contentShape(Rectangle())\n            .offset(x: x - (hitTargetSize / 2))\n            .frame(maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .center)\n    }\n\n    private func clamp(_ value: Double, to range: ClosedRange&lt;Double&gt;) -&gt; Double {\n        min(max(value, range.lowerBound), range.upperBound)\n    }\n}",

0 || droppedInvalid &gt; 0 {\n            debugLog(\"[DeviceMapView] Normalized history for device \\(deviceID) dropped duplicates=\\(droppedDuplicates) invalid=\\(droppedInvalid)\")\n        }\n\n        return uniqueEntries\n    }\n\n    // Starts the auto-update timer for fetching location\n    private func startAutoUpdate() {\n        stopAutoUpdate() // Cancel any existing timer\n        let interval = Double(settings.mapUpdateInterval)\n        guard interval &gt; 0 else { return }\n        timerCancellable = Timer.publish(every: interval, on: .main, in: .common)\n            .autoconnect()\n            .sink { _ in\n                Task { await fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: false) }\n            }\n    }\n\n    // Stops the auto-update timer\n    private func stopAutoUpdate() {\n        timerCancellable?.cancel()\n        timerCancellable = nil\n    }\n\n    // Restarts the auto-update timer\n    private func restartAutoUpdate() {\n        startAutoUpdate()\n    }\n\n    // Shows the error overlay with a debug and user message\n    private func showErrorOverlay(_ debugMessage: String, _ userMessage: String) {\n        debugLog(\"Error: \\(debugMessage)\")\n        errorOverlayManager.show(message: userMessage)\n    }\n\n    // Aligns the map to north (heading = 0)\n    private func alignMapToNorth() {\n        ",

        "contents": "    private func focusOnScrubbedEntry(animated: Bool = true) {\n        guard let scrubTimestamp else { return }\n        guard let target = viewModel.closest(to: scrubTimestamp, in: selectedRange) else { return }\n        Task { @MainActor in\n            updateRegion(animated: animated, using: [target], useDefaultZoom: true)\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func color(for entry: MiataruLocationData, within entries: [MiataruLocationData]) -&gt; Color {\n        // Use the full history to keep a consistent color mapping regardless of timeline selection\n        let reference = viewModel.history.isEmpty ? entries : viewModel.history\n        guard !reference.isEmpty else { return .blue }\n        let timestamps = reference.map { $0.TimestampDate.timeIntervalSince1970 }\n        guard let minTimestamp = timestamps.min(), let maxTimestamp = timestamps.max() else { return .blue }\n        let total = maxTimestamp - minTimestamp\n        let diff = entry.TimestampDate.timeIntervalSince1970 - minTimestamp\n        let ratio = total &gt; 0 ? ## Summary

1. **Conditional UI**: When `isPlaying` is `true`, the view shows only the collapsed play button. When `false`, it shows the full controls (quick range picker and timeline overlay).

2. **Collapsed play button**: Added `collapsedPlaybackButton` that:
   - Shows a large play/pause button (56pt)
   - Includes the pulse animation when playing
   - Displays the speed badge when speed > 1x
   - Supports tap to play/pause and long press to change speed
   - Provides haptic feedback on long press
   - Uses the same styling (glass effect/material background, shadow)

3. **Smooth transitions**: Added animations (`.easeInOut(duration: 0.3)`) when switching between collapsed and expanded states.

4. **Imports**: Added UIKit import for haptic feedback support.

When playback starts, all buttons collapse into the play button. When paused or stopped, the controls expand again. The transitions are animated.
